title: Inter's Chivu wins the Golden Bench. Is he Italy's best coach?
caption:
Inter coach Cristian Chivu won the Panchina d’Oro, the Golden Bench voted by Italy’s coaches, per Inter.it — the award for the best coach of 2025/26, his first season, when Inter won the Double. And Lautaro Martínez should rejoin group training from Tuesday, per Sky Sport Italia. Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.
